required_tests.live_replay_note: The two replay modes prove different things and are not interchangeable. The same-intent replay proves the DURABLE OUTBOX short-circuits before any call; it says nothing about github.com. The fresh-intent replay is the one that exercised the host: it re-derived the effect from scratch, listed open pull requests, found #1 and adopted it rather than POSTing a second one. What neither proves is the driver's own 'branch_head_unchanged' assertion -- see the caveat in summary.json -> honest_limits.driver_self_verdicts_are_weak.
